name: mcp-vk-ads
description: Work with a VK Ads account from Claude: campaigns, ad groups, ads and performance statistics.

token.title: VK Ads access token
token.description: Access token for the VK Ads API. Stored in your operating system's credential store, never in settings.json.

telemetry.title: Anonymous telemetry
telemetry.description: Set to 0 to disable the anonymous usage telemetry the server sends by default. Leave as 1 to keep it on.
